correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md, verify.py and all Git tree members. Exact criterion: for every inactive base vertex, all opposite incidences are selected, so inactive vertices cannot occur in both sides. With inactive side nonempty, each remaining active vertex has exactly one own incidence; with none inactive, exactly one outgoing incidence per original vertex and universal incoming choices excluded by inclusion-exclusion. The all-m,n proof covers m=1 separately; independent adjacency-based complete enumeration (not reusing package script) agrees m,n=(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,3), including (3,3): {5:54,6:576,7:18,9:2}. Logs or finite checking alone are not taken as the proof.

value.rationale: The complete cardinality spectrum of inclusion-minimal edge domination is a natural optimization invariant beyond the previously known scalar domination number. A structural three-case formula and arbitrarily long missing-size interval provide meaningful graph-theoretic information not mechanically implied by a minimum-size theorem.

final_claim: For all labeled m,n>=1 the exact inclusion-minimal edge-dominating polynomial of the one-subdivided complete bipartite graph is the displayed three-term formula, with m+n-1 minimum and missing upper sizes for min(m,n)>=3.
